name: TX-13
label: Safe R

key_factors: Jackson's massive financial advantage ($5.4M vs $14K cash)
model.rationale: This R+23 Panhandle district gives Jackson an overwhelming structural edge, reinforced by a huge fundraising gap and markets pricing him at 96%. Nair's minimal war chest leaves no plausible path to close a 20-point baseline deficit.
model.watch: A major scandal or unexpected incumbent retirement would be the only realistic opening for a competitive race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Ronny Jackson, the incumbent Republican, is heavily favored in this Panhandle district that leans 23 points Republican. He has raised over $4 million and holds $5.4 million on hand, while Democrat Mark Nair has raised about $102,000 with only $14,000 available. No independent polls have surveyed the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive. Prediction markets give Jackson roughly a 96 percent chance of winning. The district's fundamentals, the incumbent's financial dominance, and the absence of any meaningful outside spending against Jackson all point the same direction. Barring an unforeseen development, this race is expected to remain safely in Republican hands.
